import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 10))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amounts Separated by Fraud/Non-Fraud
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', bins=30, kde=True, ax=axs[0])
axs[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status')
axs[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
axs[0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axs[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of Transactions by Hour of Day and Fraud Status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', ax=axs[1])
axs[1].set_title('Count of Transactions by Hour and Fraud Status')
axs[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axs[1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axs[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 10))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amounts Separated by Fraud/Non-Fraud
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', bins=30, kde=True, ax=axs[0])
axs[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status')
axs[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
axs[0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axs[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of Transactions by Hour of Day and Fraud Status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', ax=axs[1])
axs[1].set_title('Count of Transactions by Hour and Fraud Status')
axs[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axs[1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axs[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])
